paragraphs: Rav Hamnuna the Elder. Rabbi Zeira said: Rabbah bar Sheila said: Rav Hamnuna the Elder said: Rav Adda bar Ahavah said in Rav’s name, Ketubbot 40a. In Gittin 26b: Rabbi Zeira said: Rabbi Abba bar Sheila said: Rav Hamnuna the Elder said: Rav Adda bar Ahavah said in Rav’s name; it should read Rabbah bar Sheila. In Gittin 81b: Rabbi Zeira said: Rabbi bar Sheilta said: Rav Hamnuna the Elder said: Rabbi Abba said …. Rabbi Zeira said to Rabbah bar Sheila …; he answered, “It is difficult for me too, and I asked Rav Hamnuna, and Rav Hamnuna asked Rav Adda bar Ahavah ….” Rav Chananya bar Shelamya and Rav’s students sat at a meal while Rav Hamnuna the Elder attended them. He told them, “For Rav said ….” Rav Amram told them, “Thus said Rav”: Arvei Pesachim 105a. Rav Hamnuna the Elder said: Rabbi Yitzchak bar Ashyan said in Rav Huna’s name, Sukkah 42a. Rav Shmuel bar Chattai said in Rav Hamnuna the Elder’s name, there. Rabbi Yitzchak bar Ashyan said: Rav Huna said in Rav Hamnuna’s name, “The law follows Rabbi Shimon”: Gittin 39,end of side b. In the Zohar, Vayechi, Rabbi Shimon ben Yochai says, “These foolish Babylonians did not know Rav Hamnuna the Elder’s praise.” Rav Hamnuna the Elder died before Rabbi Shimon ben Yochai (see his entry), who wept on seeing him after his death. In the Zohar, beginning of Devarim, Rabbi Yitzchak and Rabbi Yehudah reached Kefar Sikhnin, where Rav Hamnuna the Elder was; his young child spoke awesome secrets, see at length there. In Zohar Bereshit, Rav Hamnuna the Elder’s son told secrets of Torah to Rabbi Elazar and Rabbi Abba. Rav Hamnuna the Elder and Rabbi Pinchas ben Yair went out to accompany Rabbi Shimon ben Yochai when he died, for they had died before him (see his entry). In the Idra, Haazinu: “In Rav Hamnuna the Elder’s book of aggadah.” In Zohar Vaetchannan, Rabbi Elazar said, “I found in Rav Hamnuna the Elder’s book.” In Naso, “ערע״ג” [printed locator unclear; see Zohar 3:144b], Elijah did not come to Rabbi Shimon ben Yochai’s Idra because he rescued Rav Hamnuna the Elder, who was held by the king. Go and see that there were two Rav Hamnuna the Elders. It is puzzling that Yuchasin and Sheerit Yosef did not notice and write that there were two. He was Moses’ reincarnation (Ch.S.L.,spring 5,river 25). In Emek HaMelekh 62a: he was the soul of Yehoyada, who was Moses’ spark, and rose to the spark of the first tablets’ light …. It praised him in Zohar Bereshit.
